title: Account Manager
description:
About Twelve
Twelve designs and builds the world’s most inspiring merchandise and packaging for the world’s most coveted brands. With deep expertise across global production, creative innovation, and sustainability, we turn bold ideas into elevated, high-impact realities. Our clients-ranging from luxury fashion and beauty to leading lifestyle brands-trust us to deliver unforgettable experiences through beautifully executed product and packaging.  
Job Summary:
The Account Manager at Twelve
is responsible for overseeing all aspects of client management, from proactively managing briefs through production to cultivating and securing long-term partnerships. Acting as the primary client liaison, this role ensures seamless communication, alignment, and execution across internal teams, including creative, development, and production. The Account Manager will drive strategic growth by identifying opportunities within client portfolios, leading RFP submissions, and nurturing new business relationships.
Responsibilities 

• Proactively manage all new client briefs through production.

• Efficiently manage all daily external client communication relating to active briefs through production.

• Coordinate and manage all internal communications related to client activity, collaborating with development, creative, and production teams to ensure timely updates and alignment.

• Lead the project management of all internal partners to respect Twelve’s expected response times and client’s ASL’s.

• Track and cultivate new business activity, regularly engaging with prospective clients to develop partnerships and identify growth opportunities, and providing weekly status updates to stakeholders.

• Continuously nurture and strengthen new business relationships to secure long-term partnerships through in-person meetings, calls, and consistent follow-ups.

• Define and implement tailored client strategies to identify opportunities for growth, address client-specific challenges, and exceed sales and account targets.

• Proactively identify and analyze needs, gaps, and areas of opportunity to capture within the client’s supply base to generate additional opportunities for Twelve.

• Lead RFP and tender submissions, leveraging internal resources to deliver compelling, competitive proposals and secure new opportunities.

• Monitor industry trends and client feedback to inform strategy, maintain a competitive edge, and ensure Twelve’s solutions remain relevant and impactful.

• Leverage AI to improve process efficiency and automation while preserving individual creativity, judgment, and original thinking. 
Requirements:

• 5yrs+ experience in a similar role within the CPG, lifestyle, or home industry.

• Highly analytical with the ability to think strategically and be a confident decision-maker.

• Ability to manage multiple clients and multiple tasks efficiently in a professional and respectful manner.

• Be a creative problem-solver who will tenaciously and autonomously seek and provide viable solutions to both internal and external challenges.

• Negotiation skills

• Have a pro-active, can-do attitude across all areas of responsibilities.
What You Can Expect:

• Full-Time Benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, Life)

• Mental Health Mondays: Once a month our offices close globally (that's an additional 12 days per year)

• Generous Paid Time Off -- Including your birthday, personal days, and time off around holidays

• Paid Parental Leave

• Family planning and wellness benefits

• Summer Fridays

• Discretionary Bonuses

Salary: $85k depending on experience.
Twelve Inc. is committed to building an inclusive environment for people of all backgrounds and everyone is encouraged to apply. It is the policy of the Company to prohibit discrimination of any type and to afford equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, alienage or citizenship status

title: Law Firm Digital Strategist
description:
Description
At Rankings.io , we help law firms grow through GEO, SEO, paid media, video, and other digital marketing services. We are looking for a Law Firm Digital Strategist to connect client objectives to clear priorities,measurable roadmaps, and coordinated work across channels. This role reports to the Chief Strategy Officer and contributes to improving our approach to client strategy.
The Account Manager owns the client relationship and ongoing communication. The Law Firm Digital Strategist owns strategic direction, the roadmap, and the analysis that informs recommendations. Channel teams own execution. This is an individual-contributor role focused on planning, analysis, and direction, without hands-on campaign management or production responsibilities. The Strategist leads strategic discussions within client meetings in partnership with the Account Manager, explains recommendations and results, and participates in occasional in-person meetings.
Responsibilities
Client Objective Translation and Roadmap Ownership

• Assess each client’s market, competitive position, desired case mix, geographic priorities, and budget to identify opportunities and constraints.

• Partner with the Account Manager and client to establish realistic growth objectives, accounting for intake performance, firm capacity, and the time required to produce results.

• Translate objectives into measurable roadmaps covering at least three months, with priorities, milestones, KPIs, and a clear rationale for the recommended approach.

• Maintain an active roadmap for every assigned client, preparing the next segment before the current one ends. Develop longer-term plans when client goals or complexity require them.

Cross-Channel Strategy and Prioritization

• Evaluate opportunities across GEO, SEO, Local SEO, paid media, video, organic social, content, link building, CRO, creative, web, and analytics.

• Establish priorities based on expected impact, dependencies, available resources, and approved client scope and budget. Identify when additional investment or approval is needed.

• Partner with channel experts to ensure execution plans support the roadmap while allowing specialists to determine the best technical approach.

• Identify blockers and sequencing issues, challenge work that does not support client objectives, and recommend a better use of resources.

Performance Analysis and Accountability

• Interpret client performance using qualified lead volume, lead quality, acquisition costs, conversion rates,signed cases where available, and relevant channel metrics.

• Diagnose underperformance, distinguish marketing issues from tracking gaps or intake challenges, and develop corrective recommendations with the appropriate teams.

• Identify when to expand successful initiatives, shift budget or effort, pursue new growth opportunities, or change the approach.

• Escalate material risks, execution blockers, data issues, and resource constraints promptly, and follow through on agreed actions.

Internal Collaboration and Client-Facing Support

• Partner closely with Account Managers to align strategic recommendations with client priorities, expectations, and commitments.

• Lead strategic discussions with clients, explaining performance findings, recommendations, trade offs, and expected outcomes.

• Keep Account Managers, channel teams, and leadership aligned on priorities and decisions, resolving strategic disagreements constructively.

Roadmap Management and Strategic Documentation

• Complete monthly strategy checkpoints to evaluate progress, performance trends, blockers, and necessary adjustments.

• Document objectives, strategic diagnosis, priorities, timelines, KPIs, risks, and next decisions, maintaining clear records of changes and assumptions.

• Adapt planning depth to each client’s needs, balancing ongoing improvements for successful accounts with deeper analysis for complex or underperforming accounts.

• Contribute to improving planning

title: Full Stack Producer (Music Notation, Audio ML)
description:
Description
We’re looking for a musically literate specialist to help evaluate the quality of AI models working with music notation and audio. You’ll contribute to QA and data labeling across OMR, Audio2Score, and Autograde, helping improve our models and build high-quality golden datasets. Strong musical understanding, attention to detail, and the ability to evaluate musical outputs in a structured way are essential.
This role is offered on a contract basis, with the number of working hours to be discussed and agreed upon.
Key responsibilities

• Expert-score every OMR and A2S release each sprint (biweekly QA: 5-20 scores for OMR, 5-10 for A2S)

• Run deeper quarterly QA cycles with AB-tests (100-300 scores for OMR, ~100 for A2S)

• Run quarterly competitor benchmarking against N competitors on the golden dataset (first cycle planned October 2026)

• Provide fast sanity checks on model candidates between releases (5-10 scores/week for OMR when updates are available; 1-2 scores, 2-3 times/month for A2S)

• Spot-check outputs against MSCZ ground truth and flag dataset/benchmark inconsistencies

• Build and label the Autograde golden test set: record specific mistake types and annotate each recording against the score (what should have been played, what error occurred) - needed before the Oct 31, 2026 MatchMySound cutover

• Run head-to-head comparison of Autograde vs MatchMySound on the same golden set

• Extend the golden dataset by transcribing audio where possible

• Extend the same labeling/QA process to adjacent projects (AutoSync, Audio2Chords) as they scale

Requirements

• Strong musical literacy: able to read and evaluate music notation, scores, and audio performances

• Experience judging OMR (optical music recognition) and audio-to-score transcription output for accuracy

• Familiarity with structured/rubric-based QA scoring methodology

• Comfortable evaluating a range of score types (multilingual lyrics, orchestral vs. ensemble vs. solo, tabs, chord notation)

• Attention to detail for spot-checking datasets against ground truth

• Comfortable giving structured written feedback usable by engineering/product teams

We're building the front door for how businesses partner with government in America.

Starbridge is building the full operating system for that relationship: the data, the signals, the workflows, and the rails that let a company find a public buyer, win the work, and get paid.

We monitor 320,000+ public sector entities around the clock. 500+ customers have joined us since our launch in March. We've raised $50M from top investors including Craft and Michael Seibel of Y Combinator.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Your primary focus will be cloud security and hardening, vulnerability management, and the technical work behind our security and compliance program. You'll investigate findings, implement controls, drive remediation, and maintain evidence that demonstrates how our systems protect customer data.

You'll also share responsibility for infrastructure and reliability with our engineering team. That includes improving deployments, troubleshooting production issues, and contributing code that makes our platform more secure and dependable.

title: Sr. Director, RCM
description:
About the Role
Daybreak Health delivers teletherapy to young people and families through schools, funded by health plans. As our Senior Director of Revenue Cycle Management, you will own the revenue cycle end to end, from enrollment through cash, for a payer mix that is narrow but operationally demanding: Medicaid and managed care organizations (MCOs), outpatient behavioral health, telehealth, and clinicians licensed across multiple states.
This is a build role, not a maintain role. You will inherit real gaps and be expected to close them with process and automation rather than headcount. You will report to our President and Co-Founder and lead the RCM team, which today includes an RCM Manager, a Lead Billing Specialist, and Billing Specialists. You will also partner closely with Finance, Clinical Operations, Product and Engineering, and Credentialing. You will present directly to executives and have clear line of sight into the cash you move.
We will not scale RCM by adding billing headcount in step with claim volume. We are looking for a leader who treats that as a design constraint and gets energized by it.
What You'll Own

•
AR and denials. Read an aging report, know where the money is stuck, and fix the root cause, not just the claim. You will build the habit of tracing denials and slow-pay patterns back to the workflow, payer rule, or system gap that created them.

•
Metrics and reporting. Run the function off numbers: net collection rate, days in AR, clean claim rate, denial rate, and cost to collect. Give leadership a view of collections they can trust, with definitions that hold up and reporting that does not depend on heroics.

•
Systems. Own the EHR, clearinghouse, and billing platform relationships and configuration. Find process gaps and build solutions, including working with Engineering when the fix lives in the product.

•
Front-end revenue integrity. Own real-time eligibility and benefits verification at intake, patient responsibility, and estimates. Most denials are created before the session happens. You will influence workflows you don't directly manage, particularly with Clinical Operations, and drive upstream behavior change.

•
Automation and AI leverage. Default to eliminating repetitive work. You will identify where automation and AI can take over manual billing, posting, follow-up, and reconciliation work, and put them into production with the right controls.

•
Cash forecasting. Be a credible partner to Finance at close, accruals, reserves, and AR allowance. Finance should never have to chase RCM for a number or wonder how it was built.

•
Compliance. Adolescent behavioral health billing carries real confidentiality risk in EOBs, statements, and minor-consent handling, on top of HIPAA and payer audit exposure. You will build the operating discipline that keeps us compliant as we scale.

What Success Looks Like

• Leadership, Finance, and the executive team trust the NCR numbers, know what is driving them, and see them improve!

• AR is understood by payer, age bucket, and root cause, and aged balances are moving in the right direction.

• Denial and clean claim rates improve because upstream workflows (eligibility, authorization, intake, documentation) are fixed at the source.

• Manual billing work keeps getting simpler or automated, and RCM capacity scales more slowly than claim volume.

• Finance gets forecasts, accruals, and reserve inputs on time, with clear assumptions and honest variance explanations.

• Clinical Operations and RCM work from shared definitions and a shared view of how clinical workflows affect revenue.

• Confidentiality, minor-consent, and audit-readiness practices are documented, trained, and followed.

What We're Looking For

• 10+ years in RCM, including 5+ years leading RCM teams.

• Experience in one or two startups. You have built from square one and stayed flexible as the business changed.

• Deep outpatient behavioral health and Medicaid/MCO billing expertise.

• Prac

We do the research, content, distribution and optimization that build a brand's presence where AI and buyers look: LLMs, search, Reddit and YouTube. • Coach our creative producer and video strategists on production, feedback and client handling.

• Experience running video at volume across multiple vendors and freelancers.

• A working knowledge of YouTube: titles, hooks, retention, search and how videos get discovered.

• Confidence with clients. You can defend a creative call to a senior marketer and keep the relationship strong.

• Comfort working fractionally: async-first, decisive, and focused on the highest-leverage problems.

• Fewer revision rounds and faster turnaround from brief to publish.

title: Lead Product Manager, Video Platform
description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Role

We are hiring a Lead Product Manager for the Video Platform. You will own live streaming, historical playback, cloud backup and clip export, transcoding, third-party video ingest, and encryption of stored and exported video. Your work shows up every time someone opens a camera in Command, on a phone, through an API, or on a wall display.

You will work with backend, frontend, and mobile engineers, across every service our software touches. You will talk to customers to deliver revenue driving features and resolve video issues when playback, backup, or video quality breaks. You have shipped video products before, and know how to work with your customers and users to build a delightful playback experience.

We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires you to work onsite at our HQ in San Mateo, CA.

What You’ll Do

• Own live view and historical playback. That includes the player, the timeline, scrubbing, time to first picture, stalls, and audio that stays with the video. Web, mobile, and API all count

• Own cloud backup and clip export. Video is recorded on the camera and copied to the cloud. You decide retention, what the backup product includes, and how reliably a clip gets out when someone asks for it

• Own reliable, quality streaming experiences, even under difficult environmental conditions. Many viewers on one camera, sites on LTE or a thin uplink, and cameras that keep recording when the cloud path is down

• Own third-party video ingested via RTSP for playback in various formats and clients

• Own transcoding. A lot of recorded video is HEVC. Some clients can only play H.264. You will work with engineering on when to transcode, what it costs, and how often it fails

• Own customer-controlled encryption for stored and exported video, where the customer holds the keys

• Set engineering quality standards for playback, framing, and cloud backups. Proactively identify and resolve customer issues using core performance metrics for Quality of Service

• Work with sales, support, go-to-market, and design to deliver revenue-driving video products

What You Bring

• 6+ years as a product manager, currently at Lead or Group-level scope. You have owned a video area, not a single feature

• At least 3 years at a company whose product is video. Streaming, playback, recording, a VMS, real-time video, or video infrastructure all count

• More than one shipped product that an outside user watched live, played back, recorded, or exported

• Able to work with engineers on HLS, WebRTC, and RTSP, on H.264 and HEVC, on transcoding, on cloud recording, and on encryption

• Clear in writing and in the room, with engineers and with customers

• Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or similar quantitative field

• Must be willing and able to work onsite

title: Customer Solution Architect (AU, NZ, SG)

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re seeking a Customer Solutions Architect (CSA) to help drive the adoption of Supabase across a diverse range of customers: from agile startups building towards their first launch to established brands with highly scaled workloads.

At Supabase, CSA’s are responsible for the entire customer journey, working closely with our most valuable users to:

1. Uncover and understand business and technical requirements.

2. Design and architect technical solutions built on the Supabase platform.

3. Work with customers to lead proof-of-value implementations.

4. Provide regular customer engagements to answer complex questions, unblock adoption, and optimize scaled performance.

Successful CSAs always put customers first, working closely with them to become trusted advisors who understand their needs, work as an extension of their team toward common success, and advocate on behalf of the customer within Supabase.

You'll be joining our team to support Supabase Team & Enterprise customers, where you will be expected to lead and innovate around the following areas of responsibility:

DISCOVERY

- Lead technical discovery to uncover business and technical objectives, set appropriate expectations of the Supabase platform, and define the criteria for success, ensuring customers can receive the guidance they need to achieve it.

- Design, build, and present Supabase platform demonstrations to high-value customers. Leverage quality storytelling to present the value of the Supabase platform and of the entire Supabase Success team.

- Work directly with Growth team members to size deals, provide anticipated usage estimates, and identify potential workloads supported by the Platform.

PROOF-OF-VALUE ONBOARDING

- Collaborate directly with customers to determine the technical scope of a proof-of-value to ensure customers recognize the value of the Supabase platform while minimizing risk to adoption.

- Set proof-of-value timelines, business outcomes, and success criteria that ensure a customer is comfortable proceeding with the platform once a proof-of-value has been completed.

- Actively guide new customers through an onboarding journey, utilizing emails, docs, guides, and webinars to promote their rapid deployment and growth on the platform.

CUSTOMER SUCCESS

- Understand immediate custom goals (i.e onboard and adoption) as well as long-term customer opportunities (i.e. optimization & identifying new workloads) to build meaningful account plans for high-value customers.

- Deliver on synchronous and asynchronous engagements with Supabase customers, including application architecture assessments, database design and performance optimization, and proactive support to enable customers to scale with confidence.

- Serve as an internal champion for your customers and for the platform. Work closely with Support, Product, and Engineering to provide platform feedback, identify areas of improvement, while communicating platform roadmaps to customers.

- Invest in customer connections to build a trust-based relationship. Everyday CSA’s work with the production data stores of startups and enterprises alike. Building trust in the Success team and Supabase platform is paramount to a successful customer relationship.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

- 6+ years of relevant work experience in Solutions Architecture, Database Engineering, or similar.

- Strong background with relational database management systems such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.

- Background in web application development, with familiarity with Python, C# and popular JavaScript frameworks (React, Vue, Svelte) as well as Node.js.

- Very strong communication skills, particularly of technical concepts. CSA’s at Supa

title: Global People Compliance & ER Partner
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

ABOUT THE ROLE

Applied Intuition is looking for a Global People Compliance & ER Partner to run our employment compliance program and support case management for employee relations across the company. This is a senior individual contributor role to design what the program should be, not just execute it.

You’ll be the People team’s subject matter expert on compliance, keeping us compliant across every country and state we operate in. Most weeks the work is a known cycle - policies, audits, training, filings, and ER casework. Some weeks a new law lands or a situation doesn’t fit any existing process, and you’ll work out the answer and turn it into something repeatable. Some of this you’ll lead outright - on other work you’ll play a key supporting role in developing, implementing, or maintaining accountability.

AT APPLIED INTUITION, YOU WILL:

Employment Compliance Program Strategy

- Build the employment compliance framework and roadmap, spanning pre-boarding through offboarding

- Audit our practices against legal requirements in each country and state we operate in, identify where we’re exposed, and own the plan to close those gaps

- Define the recurring checks that prove we’re compliant - I-9 sampling, policy attestation, training completion, pay data validation - and the schedule for running them

- Define the metrics that make compliance health visible - risk register, audit closure, training effectiveness, ER case volume

Global Policy, Records, and Governance

- Own the employee handbook and other required employment policies and templates

- Write, maintain, and communicate updated policies; managing expectations and accountability measures of all involved.

- Build the policy governance model - version control, ownership, central location

- Use AI to improve how policy is delivered and maintained, while meeting regulatory governance and privacy requirements

- Partner with regional stakeholders on local policy, and with Legal and COEs on alignment to local law

- Run the employment records program alongside the HRIS team on data privacy and governance on employee data, files, retention schedules, access controls, etc…across jurisdictions (CCPA/CPRA, GDPR, local law)

- Monitor legislative change globally and translate it into updated policy and process

- Drive compliance reporting: OFCCP, gender pay gap, time and attendance, work with in-country partners for country-specific obligations

- Own the background check program

- Own People Compliance Training through our LMS (Ethena) (i.e. sexual harassment)

Employee Relations

Se apoya en herramientas especializadas como IBM DOORS para la gestión de requisitos, IBM Engineering Workflow Management (RTC) para el control de flujos de trabajo, y JIRA para el seguimiento de incidencias. Colabora en el diseño y desarrollo, participa en el ciclo de vida de liberación de software (SDLC) y aplica análisis como DFMEA para asegurar la calidad y fiabilidad del sistema de infotainment, incluyendo la integración de tecnologías como Apple CarPlay y Android Auto.
Requirements
Ingeniería de Requisitos (Requirement Engineering): Nivel Intermedio (3-5 años de experiencia en definición, gestión y elicitación de requisitos).
Gestión de Requisitos con IBM DOORS: Nivel Intermedio (3-5 años de experiencia).
Control de Flujos de Trabajo con IBM Engineering Workflow Management (RTC): Nivel Intermedio (2-3 años de experiencia).
Seguimiento de Incidencias con JIRA: Nivel Intermedio (2-3 años de experiencia).
Ciclo de Vida de Liberación de Software (SDLC): Nivel Intermedio (3-5 años de experiencia).
Diagnóstico y Resolución de Problemas (HW/SW): Nivel Intermedio (3-5 años de experiencia).
Metodología de Ingeniería de Sistemas: Nivel Intermedio (3-5 años de experiencia).
Protocolos de Comunicación Vehicular (CAN, LIN): Nivel Intermedio (3-5 años de experiencia).
Conocimiento en Sistemas Embebidos: Nivel Intermedio (3-5 años de experiencia).
Análisis DFMEA: Nivel Básico-Intermedio (1-5 años de experiencia).

title: Backend Engineer Internship
description:
Overview: Supply Chain API and Microservices Development
The Backend Engineer is a hands-on role responsible for the development, scaling, and maintenance of the core API services that power our entire integrated platform. You will build highly reliable, secure, and performant backend services within the NestJS modular monolith, focusing on critical supply chain logic, complex payment integrations, and the orchestration backbone for our AI agents.
Internship Details
Duration: 3 months
Start Date: Immediate
Location: Remote
Stipend: None initially. Based on your first-quarter performance, you may be offered a paid full-time opportunity, or even be absorbed directly by the client as an FTE.
Key Responsibilities & Core Projects
You will own the backend development for the most complex domain logic, ensuring scalability and transactional integrity.

• API Development & Implementation: Design, develop, and deploy highly scalable APIs for all platform components using Node.js 22 and NestJS within the TypeScript modular monolith. This includes the backends for the e-commerce checkout, internal tool APIs, and the B2B portal.

• SCM Domain Logic: Implement complex, transactional business logic within the core supply chain modules: Order Management (OMS), Warehouse Management (WMS), and Manufacturing Execution (MES). Ensure data integrity using PostgreSQL 15.

• Integrations & Payments: Implement secure, reliable integrations with third-party payment gateways and external shipping/logistics providers.

• Performance & Reliability: Implement effective caching strategies using Redis to boost API performance. Design and implement asynchronous processing and event-driven workflows to ensure system reliability and handle high-volume operations.

• Security & Monitoring: Ensure all services adhere to security standards (JWT authorization, API security). Integrate backend services with the observability stack (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Loki) for monitoring and tracing.

Required Technologies & Tools
Candidates must possess deep, hands-on experience with our core backend and data stack:

• Core Backend: Expert proficiency in Node.js 22, NestJS, and TypeScript (mandatory).

• Data Layer: Strong expertise in PostgreSQL 15 (schema design, query optimization) and utilizing Redis for caching.

• Architecture: Experience designing and implementing APIs (REST/GraphQL), asynchronous communication, and event-driven patterns.

• Workflow: Experience working within a Monorepo structure, contributing to CI/CD via Makefile, and utilizing Docker for local development.

AI Agent Focus
You will build the reliable, secure services required for AI agent orchestration.

• Agent Orchestration: Develop the backend services and API endpoints necessary to securely orchestrate, manage, and scale the AI agent systems.

• Data Access Services: Implement secure, high-performance services that allow AI agents (using frameworks like LangChain) to access and write necessary data to the WMS/OMS modules without compromising transactional integrity.

Success Metrics & Career Path
Performance will be measured by:

• Service Reliability: Uptime and stability of deployed services, achieving defined SLOs.

• Code Quality & Efficiency: Delivery of clean, well-tested, and performant code that scales effectively.

• Feature Velocity: Timely and efficient delivery of complex backend features, particularly within the critical OMS and WMS modules.

Mentorship Structure: Reports to the Technical Architect or Engineering Lead, working directly with Frontend, QA, and SRE teams to deliver high-quality supply chain functionality.

Il s'agit d'un rôle d'exécution du cycle de vente complet. Ce que vous allez faire :

Prospection stratégique et développement du bassin d'opportunités

- Exécuter une approche multicanale : Bâtir un bassin de prospect solide et autonome grâce à un volume élevé et une combinaison stratégique d'appels à froid, de courriels personnalisés et de démarchage sur les réseaux sociaux.

- Optimiser l'entonnoir de conversion : Raffiner continuellement les séquences de prise de contact en analysant les données d'engagement, en effectuant des tests A/B sur la messagerie et en partageant les stratégies gagnantes avec l'ensemble de l'équipe.

- Prise en charge du cycle complet : Gérer le processus de vente de A à Z, de la découverte initiale à la conclusion, en assurant une transition harmonieuse pour les nouveaux partenaires.

Vente conseil et démonstrations

- Présenter des solutions à fort impact : Animer des démonstrations adaptées, individuelles ou de groupe (par partage d'écran), qui associent les fonctionnalités de Lightspeed aux défis opérationnels précis du secteur de la restauration et de l'hôtellerie.

- Concevoir des écosystèmes : Agir à titre de personne-ressource experte et de confiance en comprenant les intégrations tierces (p. ex. Deputy, Xero, SevenRooms) afin d'offrir aux établissements une suite technologique globale et clé en main.

- Maîtrise financière : Mener avec assurance les négociations de prix et faire valoir la valeur ajoutée des paiements intégrés, en collaboration étroite avec la direction pour conclure des ententes commerciales gagnant-gagnant.

Performance et excellence opérationnelle

- Surpasser les objectifs : Maintenir un souci constant d'atteindre et de dépasser les quotas mensuels et trimestriels de revenus et de nouveaux points de vente.

- Discipline CRM : Maintenir une rigueur impeccable dans Salesforce en s'assurant de la précision des données de prospection, des activités et des étapes d'opportunité pour permettre des prévisions exécutives exactes.

- Respect des ententes de niveau de service : Respecter ou dépasser de manière constante les ententes de niveau de service concernant les temps de réponse aux prospects, les critères de qualification d'affaires et les échéanciers de déploiement.

Collaboration d'équipe et valeurs

- Incarner les valeurs de Lightspeed : Travailler avec une intégrité exemplaire au sein de l'équipe, en favorisant une culture de transparence, d'inclusion et une approche axée d'abord sur la clientèle dans chaque interaction.

title: Data Engineer II
description:
Job Description: Data Engineer II

About the Role

The Data Engineer II is a senior individual contributor on the Data & Reporting team responsible for translating business questions into clear reporting solutions, building data pipelines, conceptualizing and delivering trusted dashboards and analyses, and helping stakeholders move faster with better data. This role is best suited for someone with strong SQL skills, experience clarifying complex reporting needs, and the ability to turn raw backend data into actionable insights.

This role partners closely with business stakeholders and technical teammates to understand reporting needs, validate data, improve reporting outputs, and support a more scalable self-service data environment over time.

Key Responsibilities

• Partner with internal stakeholders to understand reporting needs, clarify business questions, and define the right analytical approach.

• Write and refine SQL queries to extract, validate, and analyze data from core business systems.

• Build, maintain, and improve dashboards and recurring reporting assets that deliver clear, accurate insights to teams across the business.

• Work across backend data sources, including systems such as Salesforce and Manage, to support reporting and analysis needs.

• Validate data quality, investigate discrepancies, and troubleshoot reporting issues to improve trust in outputs.

• Translate complex findings into clear, usable summaries for both operational and leadership audiences.

• Support the broader shift toward governed, accessible data products and more scalable reporting practices.

• Contribute to documentation, repeatable reporting standards, and continuous improvement of team workflows.

Required Skills & Experience

• 5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or a closely related role.

• Strong SQL skills with the ability to work independently across complex reporting requests.

• Experience building dashboards and analytical outputs that help stakeholders make decisions.

• Ability to clarify vague or complex reporting requests and convert them into structured deliverables.

• Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and data validation instincts.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain findings to non-technical stakeholders.

• Comfort working across multiple systems and data sources in a fast-moving environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Tableau or similar BI tools.

• Experience working with Salesforce, operational reporting, or client-facing reporting needs.

• Familiarity with data governance, standardized definitions, and self-service reporting models.

• Experience partnering with data engineers or working in an environment with evolving data platform capabilities.

What Success Looks Like

• Stakeholders receive faster, clearer, and more trusted answers to reporting questions.

• Dashboards and recurring reports are accurate, maintainable, and aligned to business definitions.

• Reporting requests are better scoped up front, reducing rework and confusion.

• Data issues and discrepancies are identified and resolved quickly.

• The team is better positioned to scale reporting through governed data sources and self-service access over time.

Over 650 companies and 150,000 users access the TechInsights Platform, the world’s largest vertically integrated collection of unmatched reverse engineering, teardown, and market intelligence in the semiconductor industry. This collection includes detailed circuit analysis, imagery, semiconductor process flows, device teardowns, illustrations, costing and pricing information, forecasts, market analysis, and expert commentary. title: Internal Medicine Physician (MD/DO) - Remote Chart Review, Flexible
description:
About the company
Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. This is a task-based, independent contractor opportunity, not an employment relationship. Participation is limited to this project.
Project Highlights

• Earnings per approved task: a fixed rate for each task, set in advance

• Fully self-scheduled: no minimum hours and no set schedule; you choose which tasks to take and when

• Remote: open to US-licensed physicians based in eligible US states

• No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases

• All contributors are license-verified physicians

• $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved

What this project involves
We're looking for physicians (MD/DO) with an active, unrestricted US medical license to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. Each task is a written clinical case, assessed against the project's acceptance criteria. Contributors may:

• Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor "trap" answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;

• Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;

• Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales.

Each case receives three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You're improving the AI tools you'll eventually use yourself.
What we look for
This project is a good fit for US-licensed physicians looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around their other commitments. Ideally, contributors will have:

• Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);

• Board certification or completed residency training, with direct patient care experience (attending-level preferred). Practising or retired physicians welcome;

• Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);

• Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;

• Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);

• Strong written English (C1+).

This project is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.
How it works
Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join the project → Complete tasks → Get paid for approved tasks
Flexibility
You decide whether, when, and how much to contribute. There are no minimum hours, set schedules, or required availability. Task availability varies with project phases. Tasks are submitted through the platform and are approved when they meet the project’s acceptance criteria.
Earnings
Earnings are paid only for completed and approved tasks. Each task type has a fixed rate. There is no time tracking and no hour logging. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the rate. QA and adjudication tasks have a higher per-task rate.

• $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved.

• Quality incentives: additional earnings for high-quality approved tasks, on terms set out in the project guidelines.

Over the next 5-10 years, we're hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services.
A bit about the role
We're looking for a Junior Copywriter based remotely in the Philippines to join our creative team and dig into the world of growth and paid advertising. This is a role for someone who loves writing, is curious about what makes an ad actually work and wants to get hands-on with briefs that are driven by real performance data. You'll be writing scripts and copy for paid social (still and video), collaborating with our local creative strategists and video team, and doing the kind of fast-paced, purposeful work that puts more planet-conscious toilet paper in the world. Which is, it turns out, a great thing to put in the world.

• Joining a creative workshop with the AU creative strategist to brainstorm ideas for a new paid video campaign - and walking out with three concepts you're actually excited to write

You can write.

You've got some real copywriting experience (even if it's not a lot), and you're already good at matching your voice to a brand's. Crucially, you can write with humour and lightness without it feeling forced. Our tone is a lot of fun to write in, but it takes genuine instinct to pull off.
You're curious about what makes ads work.
You don't need a deep background in performance marketing - we'll teach you the things you don't know. But you need to be genuinely interested in learning. When someone shows you an ad that performed well and explains why, your instinct is to lean in, not tune out. You're the kind of person who thinks about why something catches your eye, why it works, and what might make it land differently.
You're fast-paced and collaborative.
This is a hands-on role in a fast-moving team. You're comfortable working across multiple briefs, responding to feedback quickly, and jumping into a workshop or prioritisation call and actually contributing. You don't need every detail spelled out before you start, and you communicate proactively when things aren't clear or capacity is getting tight.
You give a crap.
Do you want your work to make the world a better place? Do you want to work with other people who feel the same way? What a coincidence - us too!
Why should you work with us?

title: Marketing Operations Direct Mail Associate
description:
Omada Health is on a mission to bend the curve of chronic disease.
Job Description:
The Marketing Operations Direct Mail associate will be responsible for:

• Partnering with cross-functional partners to plan and deploy direct mail and print marketing campaigns end to end, from intake through in-home

• Maintaining current-state direct mail processes and documentation, and helping ensure SLAs and submission processes are followed across stakeholders

• QA’ing direct mail and print materials and submitting them to vendors to ensure desired in-home dates are met

• Managing direct mail data and files for campaign submission, including segment/list preparation, validation, and troubleshooting data issues

• Maintaining day-to-day vendor relationships to ensure time and cost savings are maximized

• Managing direct mail invoice validation, reconciliation, and tracking against budget

• Identifying and contributing to direct mail process improvements that reduce complexity, decrease manual work, and help operations scale with growing campaign volume

Job overview:
We are looking for a Marketing Operations Direct Mail Associate. Omada’s Marketing team is focused on the first part of Omada’s mission - to inspire people everywhere to take the first step toward lasting, healthy change. We understand our audience, know what makes Omada different, connect these two things to tell a great story, then measure and optimize its success.
Your impact:
As a Marketing Operations Direct Mail Associate at Omada Health , you’ll manage the scheduling, segmentation, QA and vendor submission of our direct mail campaigns. As our direct mail investment grows, you’ll provide dedicated operational capacity that turns increased campaign volume into campaigns that go out on time and accurately. Beyond your weekly campaign work, you’ll help refine our direct mail processes to scale operations and increase efficiency. You’ll use your judgment within established procedures, SLAs and budgets to resolve day-to-day issues, with minimal guidance on routine work and more support on new assignments.
Working in tandem with the Marketing Operations Direct Mail Campaign Manager to plan, build and deploy high impact campaigns, this role is extremely important to the Enrollment Marketing team and Omada Health as a whole. Successful campaigns are integral to reaching enrollment and revenue targets, preserving enrollment marketing as a strategic differentiator, and most importantly helping more people learn about and sign up for the Omada program.
You will be successful in this job if you have:

• 3+ years of relevant experience in direct mail or marketing operations, including working with direct mail vendors to implement campaigns (Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience)

• 3+ years of hands-on experience working in a marketing automation platform for direct mail operations (Marketo, Braze, Pardot, etc.)

• A working knowledge of Post Office SOPs and requirements

• Experience troubleshooting data and production issues and applying established processes and guidelines to resolve them

Nice to have:

• Project management skills: you are able to work in a fast-paced environment and manage your time and projects without dropping deadlines

• Database management expertise: you are comfortable working with data to manage distinct contact lists/segments

• Experience with marketing tools such as Asana and SFDC, plus data manipulation and analysis in spreadsheets

Benefits:

• Competitive salary with generous annual cash bonus

• Equity grants

• Employee stock purchasing plan (ESPP)

• Remote first work from home culture

• Flexible Time Off to help you rest, recharge, and connect with loved ones

• Generous parental leave

• Health, dental, and vision insurance (and above market employer contributions)

• 401k retirement savings plan

• Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA)

• Mental Health Support Solutions

• ...and more!

title: Implementation Architect
description:
Role Description

As an Implementation Architect at Dropbox, you will help customers successfully configure, implement, and launch Dropbox solutions across SMB, mid-market, and enterprise environments. You will own multiple concurrent implementations, guiding customers through configuration, integrations, identity setup, migrations, testing, enablement, go-live, and post-launch handoff. You will translate agreed solution designs into practical implementation plans, identify risks early, troubleshoot common technical issues, and keep customers and internal teams aligned through delivery.

This role is designed for someone with hands-on experience implementing SaaS products who can independently deliver standard and moderately complex implementations using established approaches. You will work closely with Technical Architects, Customer Success, Support, Sales, and partners. You will also help improve implementation consistency by contributing lessons learned, reusable documentation, and practical feedback from customer deployments.

title: Program Lead, Performance & Enablement
description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At  Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.”  Learn more about working at Coinbase .

As a Program Lead, GFCO Performance & Enablement on the CX Compliance Operations team, you’ll build the learning and performance programs that keep our financial crime investigations accurate, consistent, and audit ready. The team delivers Transaction Monitoring, Enhanced Due Diligence, Screening, and Complaints Investigations, so readiness for complex regulated cases matters from day one. You’ll own programs from needs analysis through evaluation, and your work will show up in investigation quality, case handling efficiency, and regulatory readiness.

What you’ll do:

• Own end-to-end delivery of onboarding, cross-skilling, and performance-improvement programs, from scoping and planning through deployment and post-launch follow-through in your workstream.

• Diagnose capability gaps using operational data, quality results, and stakeholder input, distinguishing skill gaps from process, tooling, or policy issues and recommending the intervention most likely to close them.

• Design practical learning experiences, including facilitated sessions, self-paced content, job aids, scenario-based practice, and assessments grounded in approved compliance procedures.

• Build and maintain program documentation, rollout materials, evaluation records, and reusable templates that strengthen delivery quality, repeatability, and auditability.

• Partner with subject-matter experts, operations leads, Workforce, Quality Assurance, and Data Analytics to validate content, align timelines, and report evidence-based updates on program health and results.

• Drive continuous improvement by capturing lessons learned, refining interventions against outcome data, and recommending when to retire programs that do not improve performance.

Required Skills and Experience:

• 4+ years designing, delivering, or improving learning, readiness, or performance-enablement solutions in a complex regulated or operational environment such as financial crime compliance or financial services.

• Proven record independently leading projects end to end, including scoping, milestone planning, risk management, stakeholder coordination, and delivery follow-through.

• Demonstrated ability to interpret learning, quality, and operational data and translate findings into targeted interventions that improve measurable performance outcomes.

• Experience building practical learning content such as facilitated sessions, self-paced modules, assessments, and job aids with learning platforms and authoring tools, including validating AI-generated content against authoritative sources.

• Consistent success partnering cross-functionally without formal authority, including challenging unclear requirements and communicating trade-offs plainly.

• Preferred: experience supporting financial crime compliance operations in transaction monitoring, enhanced due diligence, screening, or complaints investigations, plus certification in instructional design, project management, or compliance.

• Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.
